newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver gains on global trend, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver gains on global trend, gold steady.

text.p: Indian silver rose on firm global trends on Monday but fell back on fresh arrivals of imported silver near close, dealers said.
Silver was up by 35 rupees per kg on Saturday.
"Arrivals of about 800/1,000 kg of imported silver were reported today in the Bombay market," one dealer.
Gold opened on a quiet note and remained steady during the day amid limited activity with arrivals at a low ebb. Gold was up by 30 rupees per 10 gramme on Saturday.
Gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) were steady at 57,300 rupees per piece. They were up by 400 rupees per piece on Saturday.
